title: Convention Plugin and Release Pipeline Capstone Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies convention plugin and release pipeline capstone?
options: Integrate tested build capabilities with one verified, attested and safely promoted release artifact.
Keep failure and recovery outside the project
questions.answer: Integrate tested build capabilities with one verified, attested and safely promoted release artifact.
questions.explanation: This answer preserves the underlying platform or delivery contract while requiring representative evidence, explicit failure behaviour, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: Passing convention-plugin unit tests alone proves the release pipeline is secure and reproducible.
questions.explanation: A polished convention plugin project without real release-artifact verification, failure tests and protected promotion demonstrates configuration reuse but not build engineering.

questions.answer: A versioned tested build platform that produces and promotes one traceable artifact under measured, least-privilege operational controls.
questions.explanation: The response identifies the mechanism that makes the decision reliable instead of relying on a convenient proxy.
